# Here are some cool plots

Here's a scatterplot

Set Up
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
```


```{r}
data("rest_inspec")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width = 6,
  fig.asp = .6,
  out.width = "90%"
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

options(
  ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis",
  ggplot2.continuous.fill = "viridis"
)

scale_colour_discrete = scale_colour_viridis_d
scale_fill_discrete = scale_fill_viridis_d
```


```{r}
plot1= rest_inspec |>
  filter(
    boro == "Manhattan",
    cuisine_description == "Pizza",
    !is.na(score),
    grade %in% c("A", "B", "C")
  ) |>
  distinct(camis, inspection_date, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(text_label = str_c("Restaurant: ", dba,
                            "\nScore: ", score,
                            "\nGrade: ", grade)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~inspection_date, y = ~score, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
    color = ~grade, text = ~text_label, alpha = 0.75)
plot1
```
```{r}
top_cuisines = rest_inspec |>
  distinct(camis, cuisine_description) |>
  count(cuisine_description, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  pull(cuisine_description)

rest_inspec |>
  filter(
    boro == "Queens",
    cuisine_description %in% top_cuisines,
    !is.na(score)
  ) |>
  distinct(camis, inspection_date, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    cuisine_description = str_replace(cuisine_description, "Latin.*", "Latin"),
    cuisine_description = fct_reorder(cuisine_description, score)
  ) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~cuisine_description, y = ~score, color = ~cuisine_description,
    type = "box", colors = "viridis") |>
  layout(
    showlegend = FALSE,
    xaxis = list(title = "", tickangle = -45),
    yaxis = list(title = "Inspection score (higher = more violations)")
  )
```


```{r}
rest_inspec |>
  filter(grade %in% c("A", "B", "C"), boro != "Missing") |>
  distinct(camis, inspection_date, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  count(boro, grade) |>
  mutate(boro = fct_reorder(boro, n)) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~boro, y = ~n, color = ~grade, type = "bar", colors = "viridis") |>
  layout(barmode = "group",
         xaxis = list(title = ""),
         yaxis = list(title = "Number of inspections"))
```
